description: Tracks which refactoring prompts have been completed. Updated by the master prompt after each session.

prompts.title: Extract CSS from build_flat.py
prompts.notes: Extracted ~1245 lines of inline CSS to build/templates/styles.css. generate_stylesheet() now reads from that file.

prompts.title: Extract JavaScript from build_flat.py
prompts.notes: Extracted ~570 lines of inline JS to build/templates/search.js and build/templates/tag-search.js. generate_search_js() and generate_tag_search_js() now read from those files.

prompts.title: Eliminate strip_furigana and is_kanji duplication
prompts.notes: Added is_kanji() to japanese_utils.py. Updated 5 files to import strip_furigana/is_kanji from japanese_utils instead of defining their own: build_kanji_json.py, extract_kanji_from_entries.py, update_kanji_index.py, verify_kanji_index.py, check_tag_consistency.py. Removed unused re imports where applicable.

prompts.title: Add unit tests for japanese_utils.py
prompts.notes: Created build/tests/test_japanese_utils.py with 100 tests covering all public functions: hiragana_to_romaji, romaji_to_hiragana, romaji_to_katakana, strip_furigana, is_kanji, is_valid_hiragana, normalize_reading, contains_katakana, get_kana_folder, get_expected_directory, FURIGANA_PATTERN, and KANA_TO_FOLDER/KANA_TO_DIRECTORY constants.

prompts.title: Add unit tests for path_utils.py
prompts.notes: Created build/tests/test_path_utils.py with 40 tests covering all public functions: get_numeric_id (13 tests), get_directory_range (15 tests), get_entry_path (10 tests), and get_entry_prefix legacy compat (2 tests). All boundary cases (0, 499, 500, 999, 1000) tested.

prompts.title: Archive one-time migration scripts
prompts.notes: Moved 8 build/ scripts and pos_mapping.json to build/archive/. Moved 2 scripts/ files to build/archive/. Removed now-empty scripts/ directory.

prompts.title: Enrich entries_index.json with tag and tier data
prompts.notes: Added 6 fields to extract_entry_info(): vocabulary_tier, part_of_speech, pos_tags, cross_reference_count, example_count, has_inline_links. Regenerated entries_index.json with 10306 entries.

prompts.title: Add a Makefile or build runner script
prompts.notes: Created Makefile with 8 targets: validate, index, build, check-furigana, check-kanji, stats, clean, full. build depends on validate+index. Note: make build currently stops at validate due to pre-existing validation warnings (10296/10306 entries valid).

prompts.title: Split build_flat.py entry HTML generation
prompts.notes: Extracted generate_entry_html(), process_headword_with_kanji_links(), process_notes_text(), render_examples() (refactored from closure to module-level function), and helpers (process_furigana, process_word_links, format_jst_datetime, generate_html_head, JST, KANJI_LIST) to build/entry_renderer.py (~340 lines). build_flat.py reduced from 1861 to 1413 lines. build_flat.py imports shared functions back from entry_renderer.

prompts.title: Split build_flat.py page generators
prompts.notes: Extracted 10 functions to build/page_generators.py (~680 lines): generate_header_search_redirect_script, generate_index_page, generate_tag_search_styles, generate_tag_search_section, generate_advanced_page, get_kana_folder_for_display, generate_browse_page, generate_recent_page, generate_random_page, generate_pending_page, build_recent_entries. build_flat.py reduced from 1413 to 507 lines.

prompts.title: Split build_flat.py search index generation
prompts.notes: Extracted generate_search_index(), generate_search_js(), generate_tag_search_js() to build/search_index_builder.py (~125 lines). Removed unused imports from build_flat.py (html, timezone, hiragana_to_romaji, strip_furigana). build_flat.py reduced from ~400 to ~395 lines.

prompts.title: Add a validate-and-report summary command
prompts.notes: Created build/report.py with 7 dashboard sections: vocabulary tiers, POS breakdown, cross-reference stats, example sentence stats, inline word link coverage, furigana coverage, and recent activity. Added 'report' target to Makefile.

prompts.title: Validate part_of_speech consistency with tags.pos
prompts.notes: Added infer_pos_tags() and check_pos_consistency() to validate.py. Maps 198 free-text part_of_speech variants to 22 canonical tags.pos values. Found 429 genuine inconsistencies: 219 nouns missing suru-verb in part_of_speech, 83 generic 'verb' entries where tags.pos has specific verb class, 16 nouns with undeclared na-adjective, etc. All flagged as warnings (not errors).

prompts.title: Investigate and document build performance
prompts.notes: Added timing instrumentation to build_flat.py. Full build takes ~40s for 10,306 entries. Atomic swap dominates at 57% (23s), entry HTML generation is 17% (7s), entry loading 10% (4s), directory setup 9% (4s). Added performance profile and optimization strategies as docstring at top of build_flat.py.

prompts.title: Create a GitHub Actions CI workflow
prompts.notes: Created .github/workflows/validate.yml: runs on push/PR, checks out repo, sets up Python 3.12, installs deps, runs validate.py. Note: CI will initially report failure due to 10 pre-existing invalid entries.

prompts.title: Reduce PROJECT_STATUS.md size
prompts.notes: Reduced PROJECT_STATUS.md from 1643 to 394 lines (154KB to 22KB). Moved 57 older Recent Changes sections to PROJECT_STATUS-archive.md. Kept last 5 sections. Updated Content Status with accurate counts (801 basic, 1998 core, 7507 general, 3313 xrefs, 40185 examples). Added archive note at top. Updated entry-guidelines skill to mention rotation policy. Changed limit from 10 to 5 most recent entries.

prompts.title: Add schema version field to entry schema
prompts.notes: Added optional schema_version string field to build/schema.json. Updated entry-guidelines skill to instruct new entries to include schema_version: "2.0". Existing entries not backfilled.

prompts.title: Clean up legacy cross-reference string format
prompts.notes: Converted 28 entries from legacy string cross_references to structured object format (type: 'related', with reading/target_id/headword). Fixed 1 entry (09667_yougu) with wrong target_id (02447_dougu -> 01479_dougu). Removed oneOf string option from schema.json. Updated validate.py to match new schema structure.

prompts.title: Add incremental build capability
prompts.notes: Added --quick flag to build_flat.py via argparse. Quick mode compares mtime of source JSON vs output HTML, only regenerates changed entries, writes directly to docs/ (skips atomic swap). Navigation pages, search index, and stylesheet always regenerated. Added 'quick' target to Makefile. With no changes: full build ~40s vs quick build ~10s.

prompts.title: Create a pre-commit hook
prompts.notes: Created .githooks/pre-commit that detects staged entries/ JSON files, validates each with validate.py --entry, and blocks commit on failure. Fast path skips validation when no entry files are staged. Install with: git config core.hooksPath .githooks

prompts.title: Remove duplicate is_kanji() from entry_renderer.py
prompts.notes: Removed local is_kanji() definition from process_headword_with_kanji_links() and added is_kanji to the existing import from japanese_utils. All 140 tests pass, build succeeds.

prompts.title: Add template file error handling
prompts.notes: Added try/except FileNotFoundError with clear error messages and sys.exit(1) to generate_stylesheet() in build_flat.py, and generate_search_js() and generate_tag_search_js() in search_index_builder.py. Added sys import to search_index_builder.py.

prompts.title: Add kanji_list.json missing-file warning
prompts.notes: Added else branch to KANJI_LIST loading in entry_renderer.py that prints a warning when kanji/kanji_list.json is missing. Verified no spurious warning during normal build.

prompts.title: Create PROJECT_CONTEXT_BRIEF.md
prompts.notes: Created PROJECT_CONTEXT_BRIEF.md with current counts, critical rules, essential commands, file placement, tier policy, and skills reference. Updated prompts/newentries.md (session start now reads BRIEF instead of STATUS) and prompts/newcandidates.md. PROJECT_STATUS.md kept as-is for historical reference.

prompts.title: Archive old session logs
prompts.notes: Verified 01_code_prompt_16 cleanup was complete. Slimmed PROJECT_STATUS.md from 395 to 171 lines by removing 7 sections duplicating CLAUDE.md (Infrastructure Status, Vocabulary Tier System, Entry Breakdown, Claude Code Skills, Workflows, Technical Notes, Notes for AI Assistants). Added cross-references to CLAUDE.md and PROJECT_CONTEXT_BRIEF.md in header. Archive (485KB, 201 sessions) left as-is — restructuring to CHANGELOG format not worthwhile since git history covers the same info.

prompts.title: Update the PreCompact hook
prompts.notes: Replaced semantic assignment-specific pre-compact hook with general-purpose reminder. Removed outdated multi-sense entry counting loop. New script reminds to: (1) update progress tracking files, (2) write session log if expected, (3) commit and push all changes.

prompts.title: Create the pipeline configuration schema
prompts.notes: Created pipeline/ directory with pipeline-config.schema.json (JSON Schema 2020-12, 11 task types, task-level branch/on_failure overrides, common parameters), pipeline-config.json (default config), pipeline-config.example.json (6-task sample), and README.md (full documentation with task type mapping to prompt files).

prompts.title: Create the pipeline runner script
prompts.notes: Created pipeline/run-pipeline.sh (510 lines). Reads pipeline-config.json, executes tasks sequentially with claude --print, runs make validate as quality gate, commits on success, discards on failure (stop/skip per config). Features: --dry-run preview, --create-pr option, status tracking in pipeline-status.json, summary report in pipeline-report.txt, timestamped log files. All JSON handling uses python3 with safe argument passing. Added pipeline/.gitignore for generated files. Updated pipeline/README.md with runner documentation.

prompts.title: Create post-task validation gates
prompts.notes: Created pipeline/validate-task.sh with task-type-specific validation for all 11 task types. Checks: new-entries/noentry-resolution/expand-short-notes use find_missing_furigana.py; corpus-harvesting/new-candidates/clean-candidates validate candidate_words.json structure; inline-links checks word link format; example-sentences checks basic/core have >=3 examples; semantic-labels runs validate_tags.py + check_tag_consistency.py. All types include baseline validate.py and stuck-loop detection via progress file snapshots. Integrated into run-pipeline.sh replacing generic make validate. Updated README.md with validation gate documentation.

prompts.title: Create status update and reporting system
prompts.notes: Created pipeline/update-status.py (5 subcommands: init, record, finalize, report, summary) and pipeline/update-brief.py (regenerates PROJECT_CONTEXT_BRIEF.md from entries_index.json + candidate_words.json). Integrated both into run-pipeline.sh, replacing inline Python status tracking. Report now includes per-task duration tracking and optional dictionary health snapshot via build/report.py. Updated README.md with documentation for both scripts.

prompts.title: Create batch-optimized prompt versions
prompts.notes: Created prompts/batch/ with 4 batch-optimized prompts: newentries.md, polish_add_inline_links.md, corpus_harvesting.md, polish_example_sentences.md. Key differences from interactive: no context reset, always commit, never push, explicit exit-cleanly, use make validate/build. Updated run-pipeline.sh prompt_file_for_type() to prefer batch versions when available. Updated pipeline/README.md with batch vs interactive documentation.

prompts.title: Generate a word-ID lookup table
prompts.notes: Created build/generate_word_lookup.py producing build/word_id_lookup.json (3378 KB, 10303 entries, 9805 readings, 9289 headwords). Two indexes: by_reading and by_headword, with id/gloss/tier for disambiguation. Integrated into update_indexes.py (step 3) and Makefile (word-lookup target). Updated inline-word-links skill and batch prompt to reference the lookup table.

prompts.title: Create a task scheduler recommendation script
prompts.notes: Created pipeline/recommend-tasks.py with 4 recommendation rules: corpus harvesting when candidates < 100, entry creation sessions (capped at 5) when candidates available, inline-link sessions when > 500 entries lack links, and polishing session for the task with largest backlog. Supports --json and --write flags. Updated pipeline/README.md with documentation.
